headline: Over 1,000 deaths from measles and suspected cases reported by DGHS
summary: The death toll has risen to 1,002, with 1.87 lakh cases reported since March 15 as the country faces an unprecedented outbreak.
details: The death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms has reached 1,002, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). Three more deaths were reported in the last 24 hours alone.

headline: 2 soldiers killed in accident during tank firing exercise in Chittagong
summary: Two Bangladesh Army soldiers have died and an officer has been seriously injured in an accident during a field firing exercise in Hathazari, Chittagong. The incident occurred due to a sudden explosion or mechanical failure.
details: Two soldiers of the Bangladesh Army were killed and an officer was seriously injured in an accidental incident during a field firing exercise in Hathazari, Chittagong. The accident happened during live firing from a tank.

According to the Inter Services Public Relations (ISPR), the incident occurred during a pre-scheduled field firing exercise at the Hathazari Field Firing Range. A sudden explosion or mechanical fault during the tank's firing caused the fatalities.

The injured officer was immediately rescued by the range's rescue team and provided with initial treatment. He was subsequently airlifted to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for advanced and intensive medical care.
The ISPR has stated that a thorough investigation into the exact cause of the accident and the mechanical failure is underway as per military regulations.
